$comment: Local template catalog of the simulator (docs/12 §8.2, docs/14 §4 and §4ب): W-01 … W-08 of every template set (`set` v1 = masaf_*_v1, v2 = point_*_v2; DEC-555), so the simulator answers whichever set the server sends. Status APPROVED unless changed through the control API. {brand} = the customer brand of brand.json / BRAND_CUSTOMER_NAME_AR (DEC-470).
